item.title: Rilke on Living the Questions
item.dc:creator: Maria Popova
item.content:encoded:
Rilke wrote to the young poet that he should love the questions themselves, like locked rooms and like books written in a very foreign tongue. The poems and letters we leave behind are a kind of literature of patience, and every writer who has kept a notebook knows the feeling of a book slowly assembling itself.
